local View = {}

local FONT_MONTSERRAT = "rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json"

local COLORS = {
	BackgroundA = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 34),
	BackgroundB = Color3.fromRGB(11, 34, 61),
	BackgroundC = Color3.fromRGB(20, 70, 113),
	Bloom = Color3.fromRGB(60, 203, 255),
	Cobalt = Color3.fromRGB(42, 103, 216),
	Navy = Color3.fromRGB(10, 35, 64),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(231, 185, 90),
	TextPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(244, 251, 255),
	TextSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(184, 212, 232),
	Success = Color3.fromRGB(83, 214, 179),
	Danger = Color3.fromRGB(217, 106, 106),
	Shadow = Color3.fromRGB(6, 16, 28),
	TrackBack = Color3.fromRGB(11, 35, 66),
	TrackFill = Color3.fromRGB(60, 203, 255),
	Handle = Color3.fromRGB(231, 185, 90),
}

local function createShadow(parent, name, size, pos, transparency)
	local ok, shadow = pcall(Instance.new, "UIShadow")
	if ok and shadow then
		shadow.Name = name or "Shadow"
		shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shadow.Transparency = transparency or 0.72
		shadow.BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
		shadow.Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6)
		shadow.Parent = parent
		return shadow
	end

	local fallback = Instance.new("Frame")
	fallback.Name = name or "Shadow"
	fallback.AnchorPoint = parent.AnchorPoint
	fallback.Position = pos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
	fallback.Size = size
	fallback.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	fallback.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0.82
	fallback.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fallback.ZIndex = math.max(1, parent.ZIndex - 1)
	fallback.Parent = parent.Parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22)
	corner.Parent = fallback

	return fallback
end

local function makeText(parent, className, props)
	local label = Instance.new(className or "TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or COLORS.TextPrimary
	label.TextTransparency = props.TextTransparency or 0
	label.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextYAlignment = props.TextYAlignment or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.TextWrapped = props.TextWrapped or false
	label.TextScaled = props.TextScaled or false
	label.RichText = props.RichText or false
	label.Text = props.Text or ""
	label.Name = props.Name or label.Name
	label.Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Position = props.Position or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	label.AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	label.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 1
	label.FontFace = Font.new(FONT_MONTSERRAT, props.Weight or Enum.FontWeight.Medium, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	label.TextSize = props.TextSize or 18
	label.Parent = parent

	if props.MaxTextSize or props.MinTextSize then
		local constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		constraint.MaxTextSize = props.MaxTextSize or props.TextSize or 18
		constraint.MinTextSize = props.MinTextSize or 10
		constraint.Parent = label
	end

	return label
end

local function createNexusIcon(parent, role, options)
	options = options or {}
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = options.name or (role .. "Icon")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.size or 32, options.size or 32)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1
	aspect.Parent = holder

	local padding = math.clamp(options.padding or 12, 0, 25) / 100
	local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	canvas.Name = "Glyph"
	canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvas.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(padding, padding)
	canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - padding * 2, 1 - padding * 2)
	canvas.Parent = holder

	local color = options.color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	local function shape(x, y, w, h, rotation, round)
		local part = Instance.new("Frame")
		part.Name = "GlyphPart"
		part.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		part.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
		part.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
		part.Rotation = rotation or 0
		part.BackgroundColor3 = color
		part.BorderSizePixel = 0
		part.Parent = canvas
		if round then
			local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)
			corner.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end

	local function bar(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
		return shape((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), width or 0.14, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, radius, width)
		for index = 0, 11 do
			local a, b = index * math.pi / 6, (index + 1) * math.pi / 6
			bar(x + math.cos(a) * radius, y + math.sin(a) * radius, x + math.cos(b) * radius, y + math.sin(b) * radius, width or 0.12)
		end
	end

	if role == "play" then
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local x = index / 16
			shape(0.22 + x * 0.58, 0.5, 0.58 / 16 + 0.005, 0.76 * (1 - x), 0, nil)
		end
	elseif role == "close" or role == "plus" then
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and 45 or 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.5, 0.88, 0.15, role == "close" and -45 or 90, 0.5)
	elseif role == "settings" then
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.25, 0.16)
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			shape(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * 0.33, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * 0.33, 0.26, 0.16, math.deg(angle), 0.3)
		end
	else
		ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.39, 0.11)
		shape(0.5, 0.31, 0.14, 0.14, 0, 0.5)
		shape(0.5, 0.62, 0.14, 0.3, 0, 0.4)
	end

	return holder
end

local function createImageCrop(parent, name, image)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = name
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	holder.Parent = parent

	local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	imageLabel.Name = "BackgroundImage"
	imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	imageLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	imageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	imageLabel.Image = image
	imageLabel.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	imageLabel.Parent = holder

	return holder, imageLabel
end

local function createButton(parent, spec)
	local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = spec.name
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Size = spec.size
	button.Image = spec.image
	button.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	button.SliceCenter = Rect.new(spec.slice[1], spec.slice[2], spec.slice[3], spec.slice[4])
	button.SliceScale = spec.sliceScale
	button.ZIndex = spec.z or 10
	button.Parent = parent

	createShadow(button, "NativeShadow", button.Size, button.Position, 0.78)

	local visual = Instance.new("Frame")
	visual.Name = "Visual"
	visual.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	visual.BorderSizePixel = 0
	visual.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	visual.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
	visual.Parent = button

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, spec.iconRole and 10 or 0)
	layout.Parent = visual

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 18)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 18)
	padding.Parent = visual

	if spec.iconRole then
		local icon = createNexusIcon(visual, spec.iconRole, {
			name = spec.name .. "Icon",
			size = spec.iconSize or 28,
			padding = spec.iconPadding or 10,
			color = COLORS.TextPrimary,
		})
		icon.LayoutOrder = 1
		icon.ZIndex = visual.ZIndex
	end

	local label = makeText(visual, "TextLabel", {
		Name = "Label",
		Text = spec.text,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.TextPrimary,
		TextSize = spec.textSize,
		Weight = spec.weight,
		MaxTextSize = spec.maxTextSize,
		MinTextSize = spec.minTextSize,
		ZIndex = visual.ZIndex,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		AutomaticSize = nil,
	})
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	label.LayoutOrder = 2

	local shadow = makeText(visual, "TextLabel", {
		Name = "LabelShadow",
		Text = spec.text,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.Navy,
		TextTransparency = 0.45,
		TextSize = spec.textSize,
		Weight = spec.weight,
		MaxTextSize = spec.maxTextSize,
		MinTextSize = spec.minTextSize,
		ZIndex = visual.ZIndex - 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
	})
	shadow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
	shadow.Visible = false

	return button
end

local function createTitle(parent, mobile)
	local wrap = Instance.new("Frame")

	plateInner.Thickness = 2
	plateInner.Transparency = 0.22

	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")

		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(86, 227, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(40, 123, 227)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(22, 74, 148)),
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = TitlePlate

	createShadow(TitlePlate, "NativeShadow", TitlePlate.Size, TitlePlate.Position, 0.72)

	for _, side in ipairs({ "LeftWing", "RightWing" }) do
		local wing = Instance.new("Frame")
		wing.Name = side
		wing.AnchorPoint = side == "LeftWing" and Vector2.new(1, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		wing.Position = side == "LeftWing" and UDim2.fromScale(0.02, 0.5) or UDim2.fromScale(0.98, 0.5)
		wing.Size = mobile and UDim2.fromOffset(36, 72) or UDim2.fromOffset(44, 82)
		wing.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 72, 127)
		wing.BorderSizePixel = 0
		wing.Rotation = side == "LeftWing" and -14 or 14
		wing.ZIndex = TitlePlate.ZIndex - 1
		wing.Parent = wrap

		local wingCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		wingCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
		wingCorner.Parent = wing

		local wingStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		wingStroke.Color = COLORS.Navy
		wingStroke.Thickness = 4
		wingStroke.Parent = wing
	end

	makeText(TitlePlate, "TextLabel", {
		Name = "AuroraTitle",
		Text = "AURORA",
		TextSize = mobile and 34 or 44,
		Weight = Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.TextPrimary,
		MaxTextSize = mobile and 38 or 48,
		MinTextSize = 24,
		ZIndex = 20,
	})
	local titleShadow = makeText(TitlePlate, "TextLabel", {
		Name = "AuroraTitleShadow",
		Text = "AURORA",
		TextSize = mobile and 34 or 44,
		Weight = Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.Navy,
		TextTransparency = 0.42,
		MaxTextSize = mobile and 38 or 48,
		MinTextSize = 24,
		ZIndex = 19,
	})
	titleShadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)

	return wrap
end

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local root = script.Parent
local source = root:WaitForChild("_NexusSource")
local Responsive = require(source.Runtime.Responsive)
local ButtonEffects = require(source.Runtime.ButtonEffects)

Responsive.bind(root)

local connections = {}
local effectControllers = {}
local sliderBindings = {}

local function connect(signal, fn)
	local connection = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end

local function getRegions()
	local regions = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and (child.Name == "_NexusDesktop" or child.Name == "_NexusMobile") then
			table.insert(regions, child)
		end
	end
	return regions
end

local function forEachNamed(name, callback)
	for _, region in ipairs(getRegions()) do
		for _, descendant in ipairs(region:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant.Name == name then
				callback(descendant, region)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function tween(object, info, goal)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(object, info, goal)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function setMenuInteractable(region, enabled)
	for _, name in ipairs({ "PlayButton", "SettingsButton", "CreditsButton" }) do
		local button = region:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			button.Active = enabled
			button.Interactable = enabled
		end
	end
end

local function closeAllPanels(region, instant)
	local overlay = region:FindFirstChild("DimOverlay", true)
	local settingsShell = region:FindFirstChild("SettingsModalShell", true)
	local creditsShell = region:FindFirstChild("CreditsModalShell", true)

	local function hideShell(shell)
		if not shell then
			return
		end
		if instant or GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
			shell.Visible = false
			local scale = shell:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
			if scale then
				scale.Scale = 1
			end
			return
		end
		local scale = shell:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
		local fade = tween(shell, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			GroupTransparency = nil,
		})
		fade:Cancel()
		if scale then
			tween(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				Scale = 0.97,
			})
		end
		task.delay(0.14, function()
			if shell.Parent then
				shell.Visible = false
				if scale then
					scale.Scale = 1
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if overlay then
		overlay.Visible = false
	end
	hideShell(settingsShell)
	hideShell(creditsShell)
	setMenuInteractable(region, true)
end

local function ensureScale(shell)
	local scale = shell:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Name = "ModalScale"
		scale.Scale = 1
		scale.Parent = shell
	end
	return scale
end

local function openPanel(region, shellName)
	local overlay = region:FindFirstChild("DimOverlay", true)
	local shell = region:FindFirstChild(shellName, true)
	if not shell then
		return
	end

	local otherName = shellName == "SettingsModalShell" and "CreditsModalShell" or "SettingsModalShell"
	local otherShell = region:FindFirstChild(otherName, true)
	if otherShell then
		otherShell.Visible = false
	end

	if overlay then
		overlay.Visible = true
	end

	shell.Visible = true
	shell.ZIndex = 40
	local scale = ensureScale(shell)
	setMenuInteractable(region, false)

	if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		scale.Scale = 1
		return
	end

	scale.Scale = 0.96
	tween(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Scale = 1,
	})
end

local function closePanel(region, shellName)
	local overlay = region:FindFirstChild("DimOverlay", true)
	local shell = region:FindFirstChild(shellName, true)
	if not shell then
		return
	end

	if overlay then
		overlay.Visible = false
	end
	setMenuInteractable(region, true)

	if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
		shell.Visible = false
		local scale = shell:FindFirstChild("ModalScale")
		if scale then
			scale.Scale = 1
		end
		return
	end

	local scale = ensureScale(shell)
	tween(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Scale = 0.97,
	})
	task.delay(0.12, function()
		if shell.Parent then
			shell.Visible = false
			scale.Scale = 1
		end
	end)
end

local function bindButtonEffects(button)
	if effectControllers[button] then
		return
	end
	local visual = button:FindFirstChild("Visual")
	local ok, controller = pcall(function()
		return ButtonEffects.bind(button, {
			visual = visual or button,
			hoverScale = button.Name == "PlayButton" and 1.03 or 1.02,
			pressScale = button.Name:find("Close") and 0.95 or 0.97,
			duration = 0.12,
			sounds = false,
			hoverEnabled = true,
		})
	end)
	if ok then
		effectControllers[button] = controller
	end
end

local function setToggleState(toggle, on)
	local onState = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual", true):FindFirstChild("Housing"):FindFirstChild("ToggleOnState")
	local offState = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual", true):FindFirstChild("Housing"):FindFirstChild("ToggleOffState")
	local thumb = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual", true):FindFirstChild("Housing"):FindFirstChild("Thumb")
	local stateLabel = toggle:FindFirstChild("Visual", true):FindFirstChild("Housing"):FindFirstChild("StateLabel")

	if onState then
		onState.Visible = on
	end
	if offState then
		offState.Visible = not on
	end
	if stateLabel then
		stateLabel.Visible = on
		stateLabel.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF"
	end

	local targetPos = on and UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.5) or UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.5)
	if thumb then
		if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then
			thumb.Position = targetPos
		else
			tween(thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = targetPos,
			})
		end
	end

	toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", on)
end

local function setSliderValue(slider, value)
	value = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	local fill = slider:FindFirstChild("TrackFill")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local valueLabel = slider.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("VolumeValue")
	if fill then
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(value, 0, 0, 18)
	end
	if handle then
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(value, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end
	if valueLabel and valueLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
	end
	slider:SetAttribute("Value", value)
end

local function bindSlider(slider)
	if sliderBindings[slider] then
		return
	end

	setSliderValue(slider, slider:GetAttribute("Value") or 0.7)

	local dragging = false
	local function applyFromX(x)
		local absPos = slider.AbsolutePosition.X
		local absSize = slider.AbsoluteSize.X
		if absSize <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local value = (x - absPos) / absSize
		setSliderValue(slider, value)
	end

	local hitArea = slider:FindFirstChild("HitArea")
	local handle = slider:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	local localConnections = {}

	local function bindSignal(signal, fn)
		table.insert(localConnections, signal:Connect(fn))
	end

	if hitArea and hitArea:IsA("GuiButton") then
		bindSignal(hitArea.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				applyFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
		bindSignal(hitArea.Activated, function()
			local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			applyFromX(pos.X)
		end)
	end

	if handle and handle:IsA("GuiButton") then
		bindSignal(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
			end
		end)
		bindSignal(handle.Activated, function()
			local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			applyFromX(pos.X)
		end)
	end

	bindSignal(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			applyFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	bindSignal(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	sliderBindings[slider] = localConnections
end

forEachNamed("PlayButton", function(button, region)
	if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		bindButtonEffects(button)
		connect(button.Activated, function()
			closeAllPanels(region, true)
			region.Visible = false
			local hook = region:FindFirstChild("OnPlayRequestedHook", true)
			local event = hook and hook:FindFirstChild("Event")
			if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then
				event:Fire()
			end
		end)
	end
end)

local Responsive = {}
function Responsive.bind(root)
    local cameraConnection
    local connections = {}
    local function update()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        local mobile = math.min(size.X, size.Y) < 600
        for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if node.Name == "_NexusDesktop" then node.Visible = not mobile end
                if node.Name == "_NexusMobile" then node.Visible = mobile end
            end
        end
    end
    local function observeCamera()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then cameraConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update) end
        update()
    end
    table.insert(connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(observeCamera))
    local function cleanup()
        if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    table.insert(connections, root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup))
    observeCamera()
    return cleanup
end
return Responsive

-- Original reference implementation from 06-ui-motion-and-interaction.md
-- Reviewed 2026-09-11. Not Roblox Studio runtime-verified.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ButtonFeedback = {}
local bound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastSoundAt = { hover = -math.huge, click = -math.huge }

-- Backward compatible: bind(button, childVisual) or bind(button, options).
-- Prefer options.visual = the stable button's child Visual frame.
function ButtonFeedback.bind(button, visualOrOptions, options)
    local visual
    if typeof(visualOrOptions) == "Instance" then
        visual = visualOrOptions
        options = options or {}
    else
        options = visualOrOptions or {}
        visual = options.visual or button:FindFirstChild("Visual") or button
    end
    assert(button:IsA("GuiButton"), "expected a GuiButton")
    assert(visual:IsA("GuiObject") and (visual == button or visual:IsDescendantOf(button)),
        "visual must be a child visual inside the button")
    assert(not bound[button], "button already has a feedback binding")
    assert(not visual:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),
        "visual UIScale already has an owner")
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Name = "FeedbackScale"
    scale.Parent = visual
    local alive, focused = true, GuiService.SelectedObject == button
    local currentTween = nil
    local shadowTween = nil
    local connections = {}
    local sounds = {}
    local originalAutoColor = button.AutoButtonColor
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local controller = {}
    bound[button] = controller
    local previousState = nil
    local hoverScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.hoverScale) or 1.05, 1, 1.1)
    local pressScale = math.clamp(tonumber(options.pressScale) or 0.95, 0.85, 1)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(options.duration) or 0.12, 0.06, 0.3)
    local shadow = options.shadow
    local shadowPosition = shadow and shadow.Position

    local function soundFor(kind, soundId)
        if type(soundId) ~= "string" or not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return end
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "Feedback_" .. kind
        sound.SoundId = soundId
        sound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(options.volume) or 0.18, 0, 0.35)
        sound.Parent = button
        sounds[kind] = sound
    end
    soundFor("hover", options.hoverSound)
    soundFor("click", options.clickSound)

    local function playSound(kind)
        if not alive or not button.Interactable or options.sounds == false then return end
        local sound = sounds[kind]
        local now = os.clock()
        local delay = kind == "hover" and 0.12 or 0.08
        if not sound or now - lastSoundAt[kind] < delay then return end
        lastSoundAt[kind] = now
        sound.TimePosition = 0
        sound:Play()
    end

    local function pointerAvailable()
        return UserInputService.MouseEnabled
            and UserInputService:GetLastInputType() ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not alive then return end
        local state = button.GuiState
        local target = 1
        if button.Interactable then
            if state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
                target = pressScale
            elseif (state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false) or focused then
                target = hoverScale
            end
        end
        if state == Enum.GuiState.Hover and previousState ~= state and pointerAvailable() and options.hoverEnabled ~= false then
            playSound("hover")
        end
        previousState = state
        if currentTween then
            currentTween:Cancel()
            currentTween = nil
        end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled or options.animations == false then
            scale.Scale = 1
            if shadow then shadow.Position = shadowPosition end
            return
        end
        currentTween = TweenService:Create(scale,
            TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = target })
        currentTween:Play()
        if shadow then
            local offset = state == Enum.GuiState.Press and -2 or 0
            shadowTween = TweenService:Create(shadow, TweenInfo.new(duration),
                { Position = shadowPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset) })
            shadowTween:Play()
        end
    end

    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("Interactable"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
        focused = true
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
        focused = false
        refresh()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService
        :GetPropertyChangedSignal("ReducedMotionEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
        playSound("click")
    end)

    function controller:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        if currentTween then currentTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, sound in pairs(sounds) do sound:Destroy() end
        bound[button] = nil
        scale:Destroy()
        pcall(function() button.AutoButtonColor = originalAutoColor end)
        if shadow then pcall(function() shadow.Position = shadowPosition end) end
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = button.Destroying:Connect(function()
        controller:Destroy()
    end)
    refresh()
    return controller
end

return ButtonFeedback
